incidents.title: API Gateway latency spike on TechCare chatbot intake
incidents.incident_description: Multiple colleagues reported the TechCare chatbot hanging for 8-12 seconds before responding. No error shown to the colleague, just a long wait.

enrichment.summary: API Gateway sitting in front of the TechCare chatbot intake is queuing requests during a traffic spike, adding 8-12s of latency before the request reaches the enrichment pipeline. No requests are being dropped, only delayed.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: Gateway connection pool sized for baseline traffic; a promotional Digital Workplace town hall drove a 3x spike in chatbot sessions, exhausting available connections.

incidents.title: SSL handshake failures on Nexthink data pull
incidents.incident_description: Nexthink data pull job failing intermittently with connection errors in the job log. Some colleague device KPI records missing from the last two sync windows.

enrichment.summary: TLS handshake between the Nexthink SOR connector and our ingestion service is failing for roughly 1 in 6 requests, causing partial device-KPI sync failures rather than a full outage.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: A certificate rotation on the Nexthink SOR side was not mirrored in our connector's trust store in time, causing intermittent handshake failures until the new cert was picked up.

incidents.title: Elastic cluster node degraded - Colleague 360 space
incidents.incident_description: Elastic cluster showing one node in yellow health status. Query latency on Colleague 360 indices increased noticeably.

incidents.title: Enrichment Service (GPT-4.1) rate limit errors during batch spike
incidents.incident_description: Enrichment Service returning 429 (rate limited) responses for a sustained 25-minute window. Incidents queued during this time are missing their AI-generated work note summary.

enrichment.summary: The Enrichment Service (GPT-4.1) hit its provider-side rate limit during a Kafka batch replay after a downstream outage, causing a backlog of unsummarized incidents.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: A batch replay job re-processed 40 minutes of backlogged incidents in a single burst instead of throttling to the service's steady-state rate limit.

incidents.title: Audit log write failures - Elastic audit DB
incidents.incident_description: Audit pipeline job logs show repeated write failures to the Elastic audit DB. Enrichment itself is unaffected, but audit trail has gaps for the affected window.

enrichment.summary: Write failures to the Elastic audit DB are isolated to the audit-logging path - the enrichment and categorization pipeline completed successfully for all affected incidents, only the audit trail is incomplete.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: The audit DB index rolled over to a new daily index at the same moment as a scheduled snapshot, briefly rejecting writes during the handoff.

incidents.title: Load balancer health check flapping - enrichment service pods
incidents.incident_description: Load balancer dashboard shows enrichment service pods flapping between healthy and unhealthy every 30-60 seconds without a clear trigger.

incidents.title: Batch job stuck in queue - Kafka consumer group rebalance
incidents.incident_description: A batch of roughly 60 incidents has been sitting in the Kafka queue for over 40 minutes without being picked up for enrichment.

enrichment.summary: The Kafka consumer group serving the enrichment service is stuck mid-rebalance after a pod restart, so no consumer currently holds a partition assignment for the backlog.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: A rolling deployment restarted all consumer pods within the same rebalance window, so the group never converged on a stable partition assignment.

incidents.title: ServiceNow webhook timeout writing enriched work notes
incidents.incident_description: ServiceNow shows several tickets where the enriched work note never appeared, even though our internal logs show enrichment completed successfully.

enrichment.summary: The enrichment pipeline is completing its work, but the outbound webhook call to ServiceNow to attach the work note is timing out before ServiceNow acknowledges receipt.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: ServiceNow's webhook endpoint response time briefly exceeded our 5-second timeout during their own maintenance window, causing the write to be dropped rather than retried.

incidents.title: Categorization Service pod memory leak
incidents.incident_description: Categorization Service pods showing steadily climbing memory usage over several hours, eventually triggering an OOM restart.

enrichment.summary: Categorization Service pod memory grows roughly linearly with uptime, consistent with a leak rather than load-driven usage - restarts temporarily resolve it.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: The RAG service's embedding cache for historic incidents is not evicting old entries, so memory grows unbounded the longer a pod stays up.

incidents.title: Colleague 360 API returning intermittent 5xx errors
incidents.incident_description: Colleague 360 API consumers (including the GREW dashboard and the enrichment pipeline) are seeing intermittent 500 and 503 responses.

enrichment.summary: Colleague 360 API is returning 5xx errors on roughly 8% of requests, concentrated on endpoints that join attendance and device-KPI data - consistent with a downstream dependency issue rather than the API itself being down.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: A downstream Elastic query used by the joined-data endpoint is timing out under load, and the API is surfacing that as a generic 5xx instead of a scoped error.

incidents.title: Disk space warning on Elastic audit DB node
incidents.incident_description: Monitoring shows the Elastic audit DB node crossing 85% disk utilization, trending upward.

enrichment.summary: Disk usage on the audit DB node is climbing faster than expected given current incident volume, suggesting an indexing or retention setting change rather than genuine growth in audit data.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: A retention policy change that was meant to reduce index lifecycle to 30 days did not apply correctly, so audit indices are not being pruned on schedule.

incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag spike on Incident enrichment service
incidents.incident_description: Kafka consumer lag metric for the enrichment service climbed sharply and stayed elevated for roughly 90 minutes.

enrichment.summary: Consumer lag on the enrichment service's Kafka topic spiked well above baseline, meaning newly created incidents were waiting longer than usual before their AI enrichment began.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: A downstream Nexthink API slowdown caused each enrichment call to take 3-4x longer than normal, backing up the consumer even though no messages were lost.

incidents.title: Nexthink hardware KPI summary incomplete for a subset of devices
incidents.incident_description: A subset of enriched work notes are missing hardware KPI fields (CPU, memory) even though the software KPI fields are populated correctly.

incidents.title: GREW ingestion pipeline - source feed connection drop
incidents.incident_description: GREW ingestion pipeline dashboard shows the source feed connection dropping and reconnecting every few minutes overnight, resulting in a partial data load.

enrichment.summary: The GREW ingestion job's connection to its upstream badge-swipe source feed is unstable overnight, causing partial batches rather than a clean full-day load.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: A network ACL change on the source feed's side appears to be intermittently blocking the ingestion job's IP range during off-peak maintenance windows.

incidents.title: Enrichment Service p99 latency above SLA threshold
incidents.incident_description: Enrichment Service p99 latency dashboard crossed the internal SLA threshold (2s) for a sustained period during business hours.

enrichment.summary: p99 latency on the Enrichment Service is elevated specifically during the 9-11am window, correlating with the highest hourly volume of incoming incidents.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: Current pod autoscaling threshold reacts to CPU usage, which lags behind the actual request-queue depth, so scale-out happens a few minutes after latency has already degraded.

incidents.title: ServiceNow assignment-group routing misconfiguration (1JS)
incidents.incident_description: Several 1JS-assigned incidents were enriched correctly but routed to the wrong ServiceNow assignment group.

incidents.title: Categorization RAG index stale - historic incidents not syncing
incidents.incident_description: Service engineers in 1JS reported that recently categorized incidents are being tagged with categories that don't match similar historic incidents.

enrichment.summary: The Categorization Service's RAG index of historic categorized incidents hasn't picked up incidents from the last several days, so its category suggestions are drifting from recent precedent.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: The scheduled job that syncs newly-resolved incidents into the RAG index silently stopped running after a permissions change on the source index three days ago.

incidents.title: Scheduled Nexthink sync job failed silently overnight
incidents.incident_description: Morning check found no new Nexthink device KPI records from the overnight scheduled sync, though the job showed as 'completed' in the scheduler.

enrichment.summary: The scheduled overnight Nexthink sync job reported success but wrote zero records - consistent with the job connecting successfully but the query returning an empty result set unexpectedly.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: A timezone handling bug in the sync job's date-range filter caused it to query a window that had already been synced, returning no new rows without raising an error.

incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag spike on Incident enrichment service
incidents.incident_description: Kafka consumer lag alert fired again this morning for the enrichment service, similar to the pattern seen on Jul 31.

enrichment.summary: Same signature as the Jul 31 lag spike - consumer lag rising in the enrichment service's Kafka topic during a period of higher-than-usual incident volume.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: Enrichment Service pod count did not scale up ahead of the volume increase; the added alerting caught it faster this time but the underlying autoscaling lag remains unresolved.

incidents.title: ROD Alert: Incident enrichment service availability dropped to 95%
incidents.incident_description: Availability monitoring shows the Incident enrichment service dropping to 95% availability over the last hour, below the 99.5% target.

enrichment.summary: Enrichment service availability dipped due to a cluster of pod restarts correlated with the same memory-leak pattern seen in the Categorization Service pod incident earlier this week.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: Recurrence of the RAG embedding-cache memory leak (see INC0198379) - a permanent fix (bounded cache eviction) has not yet been deployed, only pod restarts as a stopgap.

incidents.title: Risk_Bus_Oblgr table is not refreshing
incidents.incident_description: Risk_Bus_Oblgr reporting table has not refreshed in the scheduled window; downstream reports are showing stale data.

incidents.title: GREW ingestion pipeline schema mismatch
incidents.incident_description: GREW ingestion pipeline failing on every run since this morning with a schema validation error on one of the source fields.

enrichment.summary: The GREW ingestion job is rejecting every incoming batch due to a schema mismatch on a single field, consistent with an upstream source system changing its field format without notice.
enrichment.probable_root_cause: The upstream badge-swipe source system changed a timestamp field from Unix epoch to ISO 8601 format in its latest release, which the ingestion job's schema validator does not yet accept.
